summary:
Wrote plan.md (all coordinates, no build or render yet). Natural History: a grey-white granite ring of ranges with a 6-column portico, a pediment at y 22 and a low green copper dome at y 26 on a drum centred at x 57, plus hipped red roofs. American History: a long, low pink marble box (6:1, like the real one) with panels and window slots, a deep unbroken cornice band and a glowing clerestory and atrium. African American History: a bronze corona of three tiers stepping out 1 block per tier, copper-grate lattice glowing amber over a recessed glass base, a porch canopy and reflecting pools. Three exterior-only landmarks on the Mall: grey-white Beaux-Arts NMNH (portico, pediment, green ribbed dome, red hipped wings), pink-beige NMAH box with deep cornice band and glass recess, and the bronze lattice three-tier NMAAHC Corona.
elements.md lists each element's construction; plan.md now has PALETTE, VOCABULARY, ROOMS and PARTS below the architect's form.
Dusk light is hidden froglights and lanterns throughout, with floodlights at the NMNH portico bases.

rooms.name: NMAAHC lobby
rooms.purpose: Dark-glass lobby under the corona, warm froglight pads in the ceiling every 4 cells.
rooms.ways_in: Doors z21 x199..203 y4..5 from the porch

recruit.why: Ashlar courses, rustication, cornices and balustrades in pale granite
Hipped red-tile roofs and the temple-gable pediment
Oxidized copper dome with ribs and the bronze lattice Corona tiers
Marble panel and slot rhythm, deep cornice band for the NMAH
Hidden froglight floods and lanterns so nothing spawns and it glows at dusk
